text: dsh-web-theme-packs 是 DSH Web 插件，为网页客户端加载并切换文件夹式主题包。主机端扫描内置主题目录和用户主题目录，读取并校验 theme.json，提供主题目录与资源；浏览器端把主题注册到 ThemeRuntime，并在设置的常规区域显示选择器。主题包可定义颜色方案、CSS 变量、额外样式、预览图和字体；用户可在设置中切换主题，新目录变更后目录会重新扫描并通知浏览器。适合希望为 DSH Web 调整配色、背景样式或字体的用户。默认会在 $DSH_HOME/theme-packs 创建主题目录，不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-web-theme-packs adds folder based themes to DSH Web. The Host scans theme folders and serves a catalog and assets. The browser registers packs with ThemeRuntime and provides a settings picker. Packs define colors, CSS, previews, and fonts. No API key or external service is needed.

dsh-web-theme-packs 的功能「加载主题包」：主机扫描主题根目录下含 theme.json 的文件夹并校验配置，再生成可供浏览器读取的主题目录。
dsh-web-theme-packs 的功能「设置中切换外观」：用户在常规设置的主题包选择行点击主题，插件将其注册并切换到 ThemeRuntime，也会保存所选主题 id。
dsh-web-theme-packs 的功能「主题扩展资源」：主题可提供额外 CSS、字体和预览图；启用主题时，浏览器加载样式表和字体定义，并显示预览图。
dsh-web-theme-packs 的功能「目录变更刷新」：主机监视配置的主题目录，目录内容变化后重新扫描并增加版本号，通过事件流通知浏览器重新获取目录。

dsh-web-theme-packs README · dsh-web-theme-packs：Out-of-tree Web plugin: drop folders of theme files (colors, extra CSS, fonts, images) into a scanned directory, and the plugin registers them with [`ThemeRuntime`](../packages/client/ui-theme/README.md) so the existing layout presenter applies `--dsw-*` tokens. Multiple packs can sit side by side; Settings → General → Theme packs switches among them. This is a standalone bundle that will move to its own repository; it is not part of the shipped `dsh-web-app` roster.

dsh-web-theme-packs README · dsh-web-theme-packs：Codex-style skins that replace window chrome, icon sets, and layout are a different format. A DSH pack overrides semantic tokens and may add CSS/assets on top of the three-column Web client. It cannot replace React icon components or rearrange columns.

dsh-web-theme-packs README · Install：From this checkout, after `pnpm install` at the repository root:

```sh
pnpm --filter dsh-web-theme-packs bundle
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-web-theme-packs
pnpm dsh web
```

`dsh plugin add` records the bundle on the profile. Removing it is `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-theme-packs`.

dsh-web-theme-packs README · Pack format：Each pack is a directory that contains `theme.json`. Default scan roots are this package's `themes/` (shipped examples) and `$DSH_HOME/theme-packs` (created on first load). Drop a new folder into the user root; the Host watches the directory and the browser refreshes the catalog.

`theme.json`:

```json
{
  "id": "aero-blue",
  "name": "Aero Blue",
  "description": "Optional one-line label",

Rules:

dsh-web-theme-packs README · Pack format：- `id` matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` and must not be `light`, `dark`, or `system`.
- `colorScheme` is the base palette (`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`).
- `tokens` keys are CSS custom properties; values are strings. Relative `url(...)` values are rewritten to `/dsh-theme-packs/<id>/...`.
- `css`, `preview`, and font `file` paths are pack-relative (no `..`, no absolute paths). Missing files skip that pack and leave the others loaded.
- Extra CSS may target `body[data-dsh-theme-pack="<id>"]`. Relative `url()` values are rewritten the same way.
- Pack JSON and CSS are data. The loader never evaluates JavaScript from a pack.

dsh-web-theme-packs README · Pack format：Inspect the live token directory with the Cordis tools (`theme.exportInspectTokens`) or by reading [`design-platform.css`](../packages/client/ui-theme/src/styles/design-platform.css). A partial token map is valid; unspecified aliases keep the built-in sheet.

Shipped examples: `themes/aero-blue` (light glossy blue), `themes/ink-night` (dark navy), and `themes/misty-forest` (light fog-and-pine wallpaper).

dsh-web-theme-packs README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: web-theme-packs
  name: dsh-web-theme-packs
  config:
    roots:

An empty `roots` list (the default) scans bundled `themes/` then `$DSH_HOME/theme-packs`. Later roots win on duplicate ids. `routePrefix` must start with `/`, must not be `/`, and must not end with `/`.

dsh-web-theme-packs README · Configuration：The Host serves `GET {prefix}/catalog.json`, `GET {prefix}/events` (SSE revision stream), rewritten `{prefix}/{id}/theme.css`, and other pack files. The selected pack id is stored in the `theme-packs.active` settings section; Light / Dark / System under Appearance clears it.
dsh-web-theme-packs README · Model Experience：None; the plugin manages a browser preference and static assets. Nothing here reaches a model request.
dsh-web-theme-packs README · KV Cache effect：None; this package neither assembles nor sends a provider request.

dsh-web-theme-packs README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Packs skin tokens and optional CSS, not the layout or icon components.** A Codex QQ-2007 skin that redraws chrome and skeuomorphic icons has no equivalent asset map in this client.
- **Third-party token sets are not completeness-checked.** An incomplete override leaves built-in aliases in place, which can mix palettes.
- **Custom pack ids are outside the built-in `ui-theme.preference` schema.** Persistence of the selected pack is this plugin's `theme-packs.active` field; removing the plugin drops that selection without rewriting the last Appearance preference.
